description: Approve or reject a Rigor workflow that is blocked at pending_approval status. For governance_change workflows that require human approval. Call this only when the person has stated their approve or reject decision in this conversation; never decide it yourself. After approval, call rigor_resume to continue execution.

workflow_id.description: The workflow_id to approve or reject (e.g., wr_xxx)

name: rigor_approve
title: Approve or reject a workflow
